static_traits.name: Zhou Mingjie
static_traits.family_status: Lives with family,all family members are very tall
static_traits.social_status: Having Social support from friends and family,but not yet sharing feelings of rejection and Self-doubt with them;starting to Avoid social activities due to insecurity about dancing,Interpersonal relationships affected
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness;no similar psychological issues before;never received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,capable of self-awareness and Reflection;good logic in conversations,able to examine evidence;Positive attitude but slightly tense,highly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: I feel friends do not like dancing with me because they do not like my dance moves,this makes me feel Being rejected and Self-doubt.I noticed a few months ago at Social gatherings that friends hesitated about dancing with me,since then I started avoiding social activities with dancing,and feeling uneasy and overly self-conscious in Social situations.
basic_info.core_demands: When I started completely avoiding social activities because of self-insecurity about dancing and feelings of being rejected by friends,I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: A few months ago at Social gatherings,Zhou Mingjie noticed friends hesitating to dance with him,this experience triggered his sensitivity to Being rejected and Self-doubt.He attributed the cause to his height and his self-perceived inferior dance level,then started feeling uneasy in social situations with dancing and gradually avoiding them,affecting interpersonal interaction and overall well-being.

Once falling off the surfboard during a surfing trip,after this he almost immediately started negatively filtering positive experiences:whenever something good happened,it would be covered by negative thoughts.Even with good academic grades(such as scoring high on a difficult exam last week),he still fixates on one small error,developing the Self-doubt of 'I am not as smart as I thought',thus weakening achievement and pleasurable experience.

core_beliefs: I am not liked/not worthy of being accepted

special_situations.event: At Social gatherings,friends showing hesitation about dancing with him
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not actively dance with me or seem hesitant,it means they do not like me or do not approve of my dancing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social activities involving dance; trying to strengthen practice and observe others' reactions in order to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not like my dancing/they are rejecting me

special_situations.event: Compares when attending a dance with taller friends who dance more freely
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have the same external conditions(such as height) and dance skills as others,I will be excluded
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attaching negative labels to oneself, reducing participation to avoid comparison
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Because my height and dance skills are not as good as theirs,no one wants to dance with me

special_situations.event: After scoring high on a difficult school exam, still fixates on one question she may have gotten wrong
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not a perfect performance,it means failure and not being smart enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive self-criticism, reduced celebration and recognition, focusing on mistakes to maintain 'caution'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Getting that question wrong means I am not that smart

special_situations.event: After falling off a surfboard during a surfing trip, persistently applies negative filtering to the positive experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake means overall performance is poor,the good parts do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly recalling failure fragments,belittling success and pleasurable experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Good things are not that good,I always mess up

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by friends, dance naturally with others, and be appreciated
core_conflict.fear: Fear of Being rejected,being judged 'not good enough',triggering shame and Self-deprecation
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected and shame through Avoiding socializing and self-criticism,maintaining a sense of security

object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/friends who may reject oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: In Social situations,friends not immediately inviting him or seeming hesitant about dancing with him
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing negative self-evaluations to others,believing they do not like oneself(transference:Projecting inner Self-deprecation onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts a gentle, inquiring tone, helping them distinguish others' actual behavior from their own inferences; encourages examples and evidence testing, avoiding blame or labeling.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to share inner feelings with family and friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing expression will 'trouble others',thus avoiding exposing vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Acknowledging their considerate intentions with an Empathy tone,while gently pointing out insufficient evidence;use open-ended questions,inviting them to imagine others' real reactions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about failure or setback experiences (such as falling while surfing)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Replacing emotional expression with rational narration, reducing the intensity of emotional contact
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining a supportive and stable tone, inviting them to describe present bodily feelings and emotional vocabulary, gradually increasing emotional permissiveness.

manifestations: Avoiding dance scenes at Social gatherings due to worry about Being rejected
Not sharing feelings of rejection and Self-doubt with supportive family and friends
Bases self-worth on others' evaluations of their dancing
outcomes: Social withdrawal leading to Relationship estrangement

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: When friends hesitate about dancing together,concluding the other side does not like oneself
Attributing disapproval of one's own dancing to others' attitudes

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Over-focusing on one small error while negating overall grades
Highly vigilant and harsh toward one's self-presentation in socializing

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing feelings to supportive friends and family,turning to self-criticism and self-processing
Avoiding direct contact with others to reduce the risk of Being rejected

positive_force: Stable academic performance, showing the ability to work hard and self-manage
Can perform logical analysis and evidence examination (awareness of negative automatic thoughts)
Help-seeking motivation is clear, attitude is positive (willing to try reality testing and restructuring thinking)
negative_force: Doing 'mind reading' in social settings, interpreting hesitation as rejection
Tendency toward black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization,negating positive feedback
Avoiding socializing to avoid rejection,Reinforcing isolation and the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding participation in Social situations with dancing,and showing obvious Self-doubt and tension
antecedent: Dance segments appearing at Social gatherings
A friend hesitates about dancing with them
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic prediction of Being rejected and 'mind-reading',treating height and self-rated dance skills as decisive factors,thus triggering inferiority and Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame,protecting the self from rejection
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged social life,distant Interpersonal relationships,overall Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent self-criticism and belittling achievements after positive results(such as fixating on one error despite high exam scores)
antecedent: Completes challenging tasks and achieves good results
After recalling a frustrating experience (such as falling while surfing), negatively filters positive experiences
target_behavior.core_reason: Black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization,accompanied by negation of positive evidence and negative focus,maintaining the 'I am not good enough' core belief
target_behavior.function: Temporarily reducing the Anxiety of facing uncertainty and vulnerability,maintaining the familiar negative self-schema
target_behavior.consequence: Weakened achievement and pleasurable experience,Low mood,further weakening confidence and motivation
